rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken pattern when saying that things are arranged, planted, or growing densely.

example.english: They planted the vegetables densely this year.
example.jyutping: ni1 paai4 di1 coi3 zung3 dak1 hou2 mat6

rows.note: Use this when the objects visibly form a packed, crowded mass rather than simply being placed close together.

example.english: The words on the page are densely packed, and they make my eyes tired.
example.traditional: 張紙上面啲字密密麻麻咁，睇到我眼都攰。
example.jyutping: zoeng1 zi2 soeng6 min6 di1 zi6 mat6 mat6 maa4 maa4 gam2 tai2 dou2 ngo5 ngaan5 dou1 gui6
